name: JARVIS - 00 Migracion DB
description: Workflow de migración one-shot: crea todas las tablas y datos iniciales de JARVIS en PostgreSQL.

parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jarvis_config (key VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jarvis_users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, telegram_user_id BIGINT UNIQUE NOT NULL, telegram_chat_id BIGINT NOT NULL, username VARCHAR(100), first_name VARCHAR(100), is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), last_seen_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jarvis_conversations (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES jarvis_users(id), telegram_chat_id BIGINT NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user', 'assistant', 'system')), content TEXT NOT NULL, content_type VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'text', metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}', fragment_count INTEGER DEFAULT 1, tokens_used INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jarvis_reminders (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES jarvis_users(id), title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, remind_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, recurrence VARCHAR(50), recurrence_config JSONB DEFAULT '{}', status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'sent', 'cancelled', 'snoozed')), sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jarvis_events (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES jarvis_users(id), title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, location TEXT, start_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, end_at TIMESTAMPTZ, all_day BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'scheduled' CHECK (status IN ('scheduled', 'cancelled', 'completed')), source VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'jarvis', external_id VARCHAR(200), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jarvis_action_log (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES jarvis_users(id), action_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, action_payload JSONB NOT NULL, result VARCHAR(20) CHECK (result IN ('success', 'error', 'pending')), result_detail TEXT, executed_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jarvis_devices (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, alias VARCHAR(100), device_type VARCHAR(50), integration VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'shelly', local_ip VARCHAR(45), device_id VARCHAR(200), channel INTEGER DEFAULT 0, room VARCHAR(100), is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, last_state JSONB DEFAULT '{}', last_seen_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jarvis_error_log (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, workflow_name VARCHAR(100), error_type VARCHAR(100), error_message TEXT, error_stack TEXT, context JSONB DEFAULT '{}', resolved BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jarvis_workflow_runs (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, workflow_name VARCHAR(100), trigger_type VARCHAR(50), status VARCHAR(20) CHECK (status IN ('success', 'error', 'partial')), messages_processed INTEGER DEFAULT 0, duration_ms INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_user_created ON jarvis_conversations(user_id, created_at DESC); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reminders_remind_at ON jarvis_reminders(remind_at) WHERE status = 'pending'; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_start_at ON jarvis_events(start_at) WHERE status = 'scheduled'; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_action_log_user ON jarvis_action_log(user_id, executed_at DESC);

SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name LIKE 'jarvis_%' ORDER BY table_name;
